english.meaning: to work out at, when counted or converted
english.note: 為起來 means 'counted up' and 為返港紙 means 'converted into Hong Kong dollars'. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.traditional: 我為起來都係一百五十蚊一版啫嗎。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 wai4 hei2 lei4 dou1 hai6 jat1 baak3 ng5 sap6 man1 jat1 baan2 ze1 maa3

exampleSentences.english: So, in Hong Kong dollars, I think it’s a little over $100 per person per night.
exampleSentences.traditional: 誒，即係，為返港紙大概，我諗每人一百零幾蚊一晚喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: e6 zik1 hai6 wai4 faan1 gong2 zi2 daai6 koi3 ngo5 nam2 mui5 jan4 jat1 baak3 ling4 gei2 man1 jat1 maan5 laa1
